capabilities: Extract highlights from Markdown articles (native ==highlights==, <mark>, Highlightr spans)
Analyze highlights with context via an OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions endpoint
Generate or update one aggregated learning note per source article
Add bidirectional links between the source article and its learning note
Preserve user-written content outside the AUTO-LEARNING-START/END block
extras: API key is stored as plain text in data.json when persistence is enabled; the README warns to use a restricted, revocable key. Includes troubleshooting for 401/403, 404, 429/5xx errors. Bilingual README (English and Chinese).
problem: Reading English articles in Obsidian requires manually looking up and organizing words, phrases, and sentence patterns into study notes.

relations.evidence: Recognizes Obsidian ==highlights==, HTML <mark> elements, and Highlightr spans.

summary: AI-powered study-note generator that sends highlighted English text from an article to an OpenAI-compatible API and builds one updateable learning note per article.
